description: This PHP source file sets up dependency injection containers, loads core and custom container files, and defines error handling functions for the SuiteCRM API v8, including handlers for not allowed, not found, and general errors.

methods.name: notAllowedHandler
methods.description: Handles 405 Method Not Allowed errors by returning a JSON API error response.

methods.name: notFoundHandler
methods.description: Handles 404 Not Found errors by returning a JSON API error response.

methods.name: errorHandler
methods.description: Handles general errors by returning a JSON API error response.

methods.name: phpErrorHandler
methods.description: Handles PHP errors by returning a JSON API error response.
